items.source: Writer used by CustomLoaderLayouts to write classes into a repackaged JAR.
items.translation: 由 CustomLoaderLayouts` 用于将类写入重新打包的 JAR 的 Writer。

items.source: Write a single entry to the JAR.
items.translation: 向 JAR 写入单个条目。

items.source: Write the default required spring-boot-loader classes to the JAR.
items.translation: 将默认的必需 spring-boot-loader 类写入 JAR。

items.source: Write custom required spring-boot-loader classes to the JAR.
items.translation: 将自定义的 spring-boot-loader 类写入 JAR。

items.source: IOException - if the classes cannot be written
items.translation: IOException - 如果无法写入这些类

items.source: IOException - if the entry cannot be written
items.translation: IOException - 如果无法写入条目

items.source: loaderJarResourceName - the name of the resource containing the loader classes to be written
items.translation: loaderJarResourceName - 包含待写入的加载器类的资源名称
